risk_if_not_implemented: Without Serious Incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) For AI & Autonomous Technologies, security incidents may not be detected, contained, investigated or communicated in a timely manner, increasing their scope, duration and cost. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Incident Persistence / Recurrence (R-IR-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15).

compensating_control_1.name: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM), or similar automated tool, to support the centralized collection of event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_1.justification: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Serious Incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) For AI & Autonomous Technologies (AAT-36.10) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure event log and security-relevant telemetry reviews include analysis and triage practices that integrate with the organization's established incident response processes.
compensating_control_2.justification: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage (MON-05.2) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Serious Incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) For AI & Autonomous Technologies (AAT-36.10) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
